related.title: 倫敦陣列離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「十七年間的放大」與「尾流虧損與機組間距」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；倫敦陣列離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Scaling over seventeen years" and "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of London Array Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界第一座大型離岸風場與它的後繼者：早期的教訓、尾流損失與十七年的放大；倫敦陣列離岸風電場則以泰晤士河口的 630 MW 風場：環境限制、單月容量因數紀錄與沙洲上的沖刷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's first large offshore wind farm and its successors: early lessons, wake losses and seventeen years of scaling; London Array Offshore Wind Farm centres on A 630 MW farm in the Thames Estuary: environmental limits, a record monthly capacity factor and scour on sandbanks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「風功率與功率係數」的模型移到倫敦陣列離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「單月容量因數的紀錄」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wind power and power coefficient" to London Array Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "A record monthly capacity factor", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「十七年間的放大」與「尾流虧損與機組間距」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；倫敦陣列離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Scaling over seventeen years" and "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of London Array Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.

related.title: 霍恩西離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「十七年間的放大」與「尾流虧損與機組間距」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩西離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Scaling over seventeen years" and "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界第一座大型離岸風場與它的後繼者：早期的教訓、尾流損失與十七年的放大；霍恩西離岸風電場則以遠離岸 120 公里的交流併網：中途無功補償、2019 年大停電的教訓與遠海運維為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's first large offshore wind farm and its successors: early lessons, wake losses and seventeen years of scaling; Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm centres on AC connection 120 km from shore: mid-route reactive compensation, lessons of the 2019 blackout and far-offshore maintenance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「風功率與功率係數」的模型移到霍恩西離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「中途無功補償站」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wind power and power coefficient" to Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The mid-route reactive compensation station", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「十七年間的放大」與「尾流虧損與機組間距」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩西離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Scaling over seventeen years" and "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 霍恩斯礁離岸風電場
history.text: 2002 年一號完工；2004 年一號機艙全數上岸整修；2009 年二號啟用；2019 年三號啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2002: Horns Rev 1 was completed. 2004: All nacelles of Horns Rev 1 were refitted ashore. 2009: Horns Rev 2 opened. 2019: Horns Rev 3 opened. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
